string.text: Threaded barrel
Extended barrel, threaded for mounting a suppressor.
Faster twist rate
Barrel with a faster twist rate increases muzzle velocity and reduces dispersion.
Protective coating
Application of a protective coating to the parts significantly reduces wear.
Improved ejector
Improved ejector reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm. Improves reliability.
Anatomical grips
Grip panels made to fit the shooter's preferences. New panels allow for better grip and more comfortable shooting.
Match trigger
Reduces felt recoil, thus improving accuracy.
Extended magazine
Modern standard magazine with higher capacity.
Chamber adjustment
removing play in the chamber improves obturation and accuracy.
Balanced slide
Balanced slide reduces muzzle climb and felt recoil.
Lightweight parts
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Muzzle brake
Reduces felt recoil, making the shooting more comfortable and accurate.
Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Tactical combo device
Combines the function of narrow beam tactical flashlight and laser sights. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Reinforced frame
Replacement of the standard polyamide frame with a light-alloy metal frame increases the gun's wear-resistance, without affecting its weight. Recommended for installation of tactical accessories.
More durable parts
Parts made of refractory metals that are extraordinarily resistant to heat and wear improve durability.
